---

### 3. Screens / features already present

| Area | Kotlin files |
|------|----------------|
| Home | `HomeScreen.kt`, `HomeViewModel.kt` |
| Library | `LibraryScreen.kt`, `LibraryViewModel.kt` |
| Now playing | `NowPlayingScreen.kt`, `NowPlayingViewModel.kt` |
| Equalizer | `EqualizerScreen.kt`, `EqualizerViewModel.kt` |
| File explorer | `FileExplorerScreen.kt`, `FileExplorerViewModel.kt` |
| Album detail | `AlbumDetailScreen.kt`, `AlbumDetailViewModel.kt` |
| Artist detail | `ArtistDetailScreen.kt`, `ArtistDetailViewModel.kt` |
| Playlist | `PlaylistScreen.kt`, `PlaylistViewModel.kt` |
| Settings | `SettingsScreen.kt`, `SettingsViewModel.kt` |
| Shared UI | `MiniPlayer.kt`, `AlbumCard.kt`, `TrackListItem.kt`, `VolumeSlider.kt` |

**SPEC** describes a bottom bar: Home \| Library \| Now Playing FAB \| Files \| Settings. **`AppNavigation` only exposes three bottom tabs** (Home, Library, Settings). **Now Playing** is reachable from the mini player / destinations; **`file_explorer/{path}` is registered but no `navigate` call to it was found elsewhere**—so Files may be unreachable until something wires `Screen.FileExplorer.createRoute(...)`.

---

### 4. Navigation setup

- **No XML navigation graph** under `res/`; everything is **Jetpack Navigation Compose** in `AppNavigation.kt`.
- **`MainActivity`** uses `rememberNavController()` and **`AppNavigation(navController, playerController)`**.
- **`Screen` sealed class** defines routes: `home`, `library`, `now_playing`, `equalizer`, `file_explorer/{path}`, `album/{albumId}`, `artist/{artistId}`, `playlist/{playlistId}`, `settings`.
- Bottom nav is hidden on **`now_playing`** (`routesWithoutBottomNav`).
- **`MiniPlayer`** sits above the bar when a track is loaded; tap opens Now Playing.

---

### 5. `PlayerController` and how audio plays

- **`MusicPlayerService`** (`MediaSessionService`) creates **ExoPlayer** with media usage, **audio focus**, **`setHandleAudioBecomingNoisy(true)`**, and a **MediaSession**; session extras publish **`audioSessionId`** when playback reaches `STATE_READY`.
- **`PlayerController`** (singleton, Hilt-injected) builds **`MediaController`** from a **`SessionToken`** for `MusicPlayerService`, listens for **`audioSessionId`** in session extras, then attaches **Equalizer, BassBoost, Virtualizer, LoudnessEnhancer** to that session.
- **Playback:** `playQueue(tracks, startIndex)` sets **`MediaItem`s** with `mediaId = track.id`, **`setUri(filePath)`**, and metadata; calls **`setMediaItems` → `prepare()` → `play()`**. Volume uses **`VolumeUtil.levelToGain`** on the controller. Shuffle/repeat/volume persist via **DataStore**.
- There is **no `PlayerRepository`** class.

---

### 6. Library re-scan (MediaStore, “LibraryRepository”, scanning)

- **`MediaStoreScanner`**: queries **`MediaStore.Audio.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI`**, filters `IS_MUSIC = 1` and duration > 5s, enriches with **`MediaMetadataRetriever`** for sample rate/bit depth, builds **tracks + derived albums/artists**.
- **`MusicRepository.scanLibrary()`** calls `scanner.scan()`, **upserts** Room DAOs, then **deletes stale** tracks/albums/artists by ID sets from the scan.
- **`LibraryScanWorker`** (Hilt **Worker**) runs `repo.scanLibrary` with **WorkManager progress** (every 25 items + last).
- **`HomeViewModel`**: **`triggerScanIfFirstLaunch()`** enqueues unique work once (DataStore `has_scanned`); **`rescan()`** uses **`REPLACE`**. Observes work by tag for progress UI.
- **No `ContentObserver` / `MediaScannerConnection` usage** in `app/src/main/java` for auto-rescan on store changes (SPEC describes it; not implemented in source search).

---

### 7. File explorer code

- **`FileManager`**: `Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory()`, list/rename/delete/copy/move/mkdir; **`FileItem`** + extension-based **`isAudioFile`**.
- **`FileRepository`**: thin wrapper over `FileManager`.
- **`FileExplorerViewModel`**: navigation, selection, clipboard cut/copy/paste, rename, delete, new folder.
- **`FileExplorerScreen`**: top bar, breadcrumbs, list, bottom bar, dialogs; **Play / Add to playlist / tap-to-play** are **TODO** in UI.

**JAudioTagger** is on the classpath (`libs.versions.toml` / `build.gradle.kts`) but **no Kotlin imports** of `org.jthink` / `jaudiotagger` under `app/src/main/java` yet.

---

### 8–10. Dependencies, SPEC, manifest, ViewModels & repositories

- **App `build.gradle.kts`**: Compose, Navigation, **Media3 ExoPlayer + session + UI + common**, **Room + KSP**, **Hilt + `hilt-navigation-compose` + `hilt-work`**, DataStore, Coil, WorkManager, Coroutines, Accompanist Permissions, **JAudioTagger** (`net.jthink:jaudiotagger`), tests. Version catalog: **`gradle/libs.versions.toml`** (media3 **1.5.1**, room **2.7.0**, hilt **2.54**, jaudiotagger **3.0.1**, etc.).

**ViewModel classes (10):** `HomeViewModel`, `LibraryViewModel`, `NowPlayingViewModel`, `EqualizerViewModel`, `FileExplorerViewModel`, `AlbumDetailViewModel`, `ArtistDetailViewModel`, `PlaylistViewModel`, `SettingsViewModel`.

**Repository classes (2):** `MusicRepository`, `FileRepository`.

---

## Full file contents (requested)

### `SPEC.md`

The file is **714 lines**. It is on disk at:

`c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\SPEC.md`

It covers overview, architecture, all screens, features (queue, search, notification, audio focus, replay gain, sleep timer), ExoPlayer/EQ/volume/file explorer/library/DB/permissions/dependencies/roadmap/S24 notes. Opening that path in the editor shows the **complete** specification.

### `AndroidManifest.xml` (main source)

```1:89:app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools">

    <!-- ===== PERMISSIONS ===== -->

    <!-- Read audio files (Android 13+) -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO" />

    <!-- Full filesystem access for File Explorer feature -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE"
        tools:ignore="ScopedStorage" />

    <!-- Required for foreground playback service -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK" />

    <!-- Prevent CPU from sleeping during playback -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.WAKE_LOCK" />

    <!-- Restore playback state after device reboot -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED" />

    <!-- Post notification for persistent player notification (Android 13+) -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS" />

    <!-- Haptic feedback on volume slider -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.VIBRATE" />

    <application
        android:name=".MusicPlayerApp"
        android:allowBackup="true"
        android:icon="@mipmap/ic_launcher"
        android:label="@string/app_name"
        android:roundIcon="@mipmap/ic_launcher_round"
        android:supportsRtl="true"
        android:theme="@style/Theme.MusicPlayer"
        android:largeHeap="true"
        tools:targetApi="33">

        <!-- ===== MAIN ACTIVITY ===== -->
        <activity
            android:name=".MainActivity"
            android:exported="true"
            android:windowSoftInputMode="adjustResize"
            android:theme="@style/Theme.MusicPlayer">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN" />
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER" />
            </intent-filter>
        </activity>

        <!-- ===== MEDIA PLAYBACK SERVICE ===== -->
        <service
            android:name=".service.MusicPlayerService"
            android:exported="true"
            android:foregroundServiceType="mediaPlayback">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="androidx.media3.session.MediaSessionService" />
                <action android:name="android.media.browse.MediaBrowserService" />
            </intent-filter>
        </service>

        <!-- ===== BOOT RECEIVER (restore session after reboot) ===== -->
        <receiver
            android:name=".service.BootReceiver"
            android:exported="true">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.BOOT_COMPLETED" />
            </intent-filter>
        </receiver>

        <!-- WorkManager uses HiltWorkerFactory via Configuration.Provider in MusicPlayerApp.
             The default App Startup initializer must be removed to avoid a conflict. -->
        <provider
            android:name="androidx.startup.InitializationProvider"
            android:authorities="${applicationId}.androidx-startup"
            android:exported="false"
            tools:node="merge">
            <meta-data
                android:name="androidx.work.WorkManagerInitializer"
                android:value="androidx.startup"
                tools:node="remove" />
        </provider>

    </application>

</manifest>
```

### File Explorer — full sources

Already shown above as citations; they are **`FileExplorerScreen.kt`** (273 lines) and **`FileExplorerViewModel.kt`** (125 lines) at:

- `app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/ui/screens/fileexplorer/FileExplorerScreen.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/ui/screens/fileexplorer/FileExplorerViewModel.kt`

(Re-read those files locally for every line—they match the snippets from the exploration pass.)

### `PlayerController.kt` — full path

Complete file (**312 lines**):  
`app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/service/PlayerController.kt`

The full implementation is captured in the read from lines **1–312** in session (singleton, `MediaController`, `MusicRepository`, audio effects, `playQueue`, `Track.toMediaItem()`, etc.). **`PlayerRepository` does not exist.**

### Scanning logic — `MusicRepository` + scanner + worker

- **`MusicRepository.kt`**: Lines **54–69** orchestrate **`MediaStoreScanner` + DAO upserts + stale deletes** (`app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/data/repository/MusicRepository.kt`).
- **`MediaStoreScanner.kt`**: **168 lines**, full scanning implementation (`app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/data/local/mediastore/MediaStoreScanner.kt`).
- **`LibraryScanWorker.kt`**: **`app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/data/worker/LibraryScanWorker.kt`**.

No separate **`LibraryRepository`**.

---

### Navigation graph / NavHost

Implemented only in Compose—**`NavHost` inside `AppNavigation`** (see **`app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/ui/navigation/AppNavigation.kt`**, **`composable(...) { ... }`** entries for each route)—not as `res/navigation/*.xml`.

---

### Screens / composables (named `@Composable`)

**Screen-level (`*Screen.kt`):** `HomeScreen`, `LibraryScreen`, `NowPlayingScreen`, `EqualizerScreen`, `FileExplorerScreen`, `AlbumDetailScreen`, `ArtistDetailScreen`, `PlaylistScreen`, `SettingsScreen`.

**Shared:** `MiniPlayer`, `AlbumCard`, `TrackListItem`, `VolumeSlider`, plus theme (`MusicPlayerTheme`, etc. in `ui/theme/`). **`AppNavigation`** is `@Composable`.

---

### Extra notes

- **`FileExplorerViewModel.paste()`** failure path uses **`it.toString()`** on the **`Result` receiver** shadowing—not the **`Throwable`**—so error strings may be wrong; worth fixing later in Agent mode.
- **Room / Hilt / JAudioTagger**: Room and Hilt are wired in Gradle and DI; JAudioTagger is a dependency **without Kotlin usage yet**.
